module: 2D simplex noise (Perlin's simplicial grid) with a fixed permutation table, hence deterministic. Optimized for millions of samples (precomputed skew factors, gradients in two flat arrays, precomputed gradient indices). Used by editor tools for reproducible pseudo-random variations.
usage:
local simplex = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_simplex
local n = simplex.noise(x * 0.05, y * 0.05)
notes: Periodic with 256 cells in i and j (i % 256, j % 256).
The auto page flags an assigned global "i": these are `for i = ...` loop variables, not a real global.
